title: Trunk muscle EMG (%MVC) in static forward bending at five hand heights, no exoskeleton
subcategory: static posture EMG (forward bending, no load)

quantity.name: EMG amplitude
quantity.definition: median (Q1-Q3) over subjects of mean normalised EMG during 5 s hold, averaged over left/right sides

source.authors: Koopman AS, Kingma I, Faber GS, de Looze MP, van Dieën JH

protocol.summary: Static forward bending, arms hanging, hands at 5 predetermined heights relative to upright standing hand height (100% = upright, 75%, 50%, 25%, 0% = floor); knees as straight as possible without locking; ~5 s hold; NO hand load; WITHOUT exoskeleton condition only. Bilateral surface EMG (averaged over left and right): rectus abdominis (RA), external oblique (EO), anterior internal oblique (IO), iliocostalis (IL), longissimus pars lumborum (LL); electrode locations per Kingma et al. 2010 (Ergonomics 53:1228) — vertebral levels / distances from midline NOT stated in this paper. %MVC; MVCs for back and abdominal muscles obtained in supine posture following McGill 1991; EMG full-wave rectified, low-pass 2.5 Hz, mean over 5 s hold.
how_to_simulate: Scale model to a 184 cm, 74.8 kg male; no hand load, arms hanging vertically
Impose measured postures per hand height (WITHOUT means, Fig. 4): trunk inclination 0/66/93/113/126 deg, hip flexion -3/25/42/61/70 deg, lumbar flexion ~0/50/61/66/69 deg for 100/75/50/25/0%
Solve static muscle forces; include passive tissues (subjects near/over 100% lumbar ROM at 25-0% show flexion-relaxation)
Compare activations of iliocostalis, longissimus pars lumborum, rectus abdominis, external oblique and internal oblique (bilateral mean) with medians/IQR

subject_model.source: Koopman 2019 Methods 2.2 (mean of 11 males; height 1.84 ± 0.07 m, mass 74.8 ± 7.4 kg)

protocol.notes: Mean (n=11) WITHOUT values printed on Fig. 4 bars: trunk inclination 0/66/93/113/126 deg, hip flexion -3/25/42/61/70 deg, lumbar flexion ~0/50/61/66/69 deg (100% value hidden, ~0), % of max lumbar flexion (Fig. 5A) ?/76/93/100/104 % at 100/75/50/25/0% hand height. Exoskeleton (LOW/HIGH) conditions not extracted (not a benchmark). Medians printed below each box in Fig. 5 (integer); Q1/Q3 pixel-digitised. Strong between-subject variability due to flexion-relaxation.

extraction.from: Fig. 5 B-F (WITHOUT boxes); medians from integer labels printed under boxes where visible
extraction.uncertainty: printed medians ±0.5 %MVC (rounding); digitised medians/quartiles ±0.5 %MVC (IL, IO, RA), ±1 %MVC (LL), ±1.5 %MVC (EO)
extraction.check_notes: Medians re-read from 300-dpi render; pixel medians agree with printed integers (e.g. IL 75%: pixel 12.2 vs printed 12; text states median IL 12% MVC at 75%). Q1/Q3 re-digitised on independent run (IL 75%: 4.5/17.1 both runs). Where boxes were compressed (RA/EO at 100-50%) lines overlap; values given are approximate.

pass_rule.rule: model activation within Q1-Q3 of measured EMG
